title: Resolve an optimistic commit race
description: Choose a pending operation and the commit that wins first. The lab refreshes the file set, validates assumptions, and either reuses prepared artifacts or stops for a replan.

baseSnapshot.detail: Both writers plan from the same committed snapshot.

operations.label: Append file D
operations.description: Add one immutable data file and its prepared manifest.
operations.reusableArtifact: The new data file and append manifest can be reused when the append is reapplied to refreshed metadata.

operations.label: Compact files A + B
operations.description: Replace two existing files with one file while preserving their logical rows.
operations.reusableArtifact: The compacted output is reusable only while both source files remain in the refreshed snapshot.

conflicts.label: Another writer appends C
conflicts.description: The winner adds an independent file and leaves every base file in the table.

conflicts.label: Another writer removes Z
conflicts.description: The winner removes a file outside the compaction's source set.

conflicts.label: Another writer rewrites B
conflicts.description: The winner removes file B and publishes a replacement before the pending writer can swap metadata.
